title: sre-weekly-update-2026-06-13
body:
Week: 2026-06-07 -> 2026-06-13
Owners: Ava Martinez (SRE lead)
Summary:
- Overall week marked by two customer-impacting events: a deploy-related cache key collision that produced a burst of 500s for text-generation endpoints and a brief planned maintenance that overran in eu-west-1.
- Primary focus this week: finalize postmortem and remediation for INC-2026-21, tighten deploy gating, and add SLO alert tuning to reduce noisy paging.

Incidents (high level):
1) INC-2026-21 — Cache key collision on runtime prefixing (major)
   - Timeline: 2026-06-09 03:12 UTC — 2026-06-09 04:05 UTC (53m total impact)
   - Impact: ~7% increase in 5xx rate across hosted text-generation endpoints; several customer sessions experienced truncated streams and retry storms.
   - Root cause (summary): A runtime change to prefix KV-cache keys for multi-tenant isolation (PR 812) introduced a corner-case where identical prefix generation for a small fraction of models caused cache key collisions between tenants. Collision caused malformed KV entries and invalidated some streaming sessions, surfacing 500s.
   - Mitigation: Rolled back the deploy (00:20 rollback window) and redeployed a hotfix that restored previous prefixing behavior plus additional validation checks.
   - Follow-ups: see Postmortem (CONF-9876). Action items created (SRE-3421).

2) Maintenance overrun — eu-west-1 scheduled network maintenance
   - Timeline: 2026-06-11 01:00 UTC planned; partial service degradation 01:50–02:10 UTC due to a routing table update rollback taking longer than expected.
   - Impact: brief increased tail latency and a small number of timed-out requests for Dedicated customers in eu-west-1. No customer data loss.
   - Mitigation: manual rollback of the network change and extended monitoring.

SLOs & Metrics (this week):
- Availability target (hosted API read endpoints): 99.95% monthly
- Weekly availability (hosted text-generation): 99.92% (down from 99.99% baseline previous week) — incident INC-2026-21 is primary contributor.
- Error budget (30d rolling): 0.18% remaining for hosted text-generation.
- Latency (hosted text-gen) Snapshot (service-wide): p50=62ms, p95=320ms, p99=880ms. Notable p95 spikes during incidents; baseline p95 usually ~200–250ms.
- Embeddings endpoints: p50=48ms, p95=210ms, availability=99.98% this week.
- Paging noise: number of P1 pages from SLO alerts increased 40% due to insufficient aggregation/windowing on error-rate alerts.

On-call rota & handoffs:
- Week cover: 2026-06-07 -> 2026-06-13
  - Primary on-call (PagerDuty): Ravi Patel (2026-06-07 08:00 -> 2026-06-09 20:00 UTC), then Lena Sørensen (2026-06-09 20:00 -> 2026-06-12 08:00 UTC), Marcus Chen (2026-06-12 08:00 -> 2026-06-14 08:00 UTC).
  - Handoff notes: Ravi handed off to Lena at 2026-06-09 20:00 UTC during active mitigation of INC-2026-21; an explicit sync was done in #sre-oncall with incident checklist.
  - Lessons: ensure handoff includes active incident context and rolling logs; we will add an on-call handoff checklist doc next week.

Operational changes & action items (owner - due):
- SRE-3421: Add unit/integration tests for cache-prefix generation + reproducible test case for collision (Marcus Chen - due 2026-06-20).
- SRE-3422: Harden deploy gating for runtime prefix changes (block merges without integration test pass & canary on 1% traffic) (Ravi Patel - due 2026-06-24).
- SRE-3423: Tune SLO alert aggregation (increase evaluation window for error-rate alarms to reduce noise) (Lena Sørensen - due 2026-06-18).
- SRE-3424: Create on-call handoff checklist and add to onboarding playbooks (Ava Martinez - due 2026-06-17).
- SRE-3425: Add KV-store corruption detection monitoring (alert on unexpected key TTLs/format variance) (Infra team - owner TBD, initial draft due 2026-06-25).

Follow-ups and notes for next week:
- Finalize postmortem for INC-2026-21 and circulate to customer-success for customer-facing summary.
- Run a deploy rehearsal for runtime changes in staging with synthetic traffic patterns mimicking multi-tenant workload.
- Review Dedicated customer impact matrix for maintenance windows in eu-west-1 and update customer-facing calendar.
- Evaluate extending canary windows for risky runtime changes from 1h -> 4h for model-serving infra.

Attachments / useful links: 
- Postmortem (detailed): CONF-9876
- Jira tickets: SRE-3421, SRE-3422, SRE-3423, SRE-3424
- PR with the reverted change / hotfix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/812
- Slack incident channel: #sre-incidents (thread pinned)

Notes to leadership:
- Incident exposure is within our short-term error budget but highlights two operational gaps: insufficient testing coverage for tenant-isolation logic and noisy SLO alerts that cause cognitive load for on-call.
- Recommended near-term investments: invest 1 engineer-week on test harness for KV-prefixing and prioritize SRE-3423 to reduce noisy paging.

This update prepared by: Ava Martinez (SRE lead)
Reviewed by: Ravi Patel, Lena Sørensen
